_readme: tests/e2e_test.py is CI-ONLY: it runs inside the Hub E2E (test hub) workflow against the sacrificial test hub and refuses to start anywhere else (Actions runner + cloud-relay base URL + the hub's _TEST_HUB_LEASED_BY variable, no override). Its cleanup sweep deletes every mcp-rm-backup-*.json rollback baseline and forces MCP settings. tests/sdk_conformance_test.py shares this config and may be run locally.
